**Revenue Growth**  
NVIDIA is experiencing explosive revenue growth, with revenue more than doubling in both 2024 (+125.9%) and 2025 (+114.2%), and a projected CAGR of 68.3% through 2027. Growth moderates to mid-single digits after 2026, indicating a transition from hypergrowth to a more normalized expansion rate.

**Gross Profit Margin**  
Gross profit margin (Contribution Margin) has rebounded sharply from 56.9% in 2023 to over 70% in 2024, and is expected to remain robust at 72–74% through 2027, reflecting strong pricing power and favorable product mix.

**SG&A Expense Margin**  
SG&A as a percentage of revenue is declining significantly—from 9% in 2023 to just 0.6% by 2027—demonstrating substantial operating leverage as rapid revenue growth far outpaces operating expense increases.

**EBITDA Margin**  
EBITDA margin has surged from 22.2% in 2023 to 58.4% in 2024, with further improvement to over 70% projected by 2027, positioning NVIDIA well ahead of peers and signaling exceptional scalability and profitability.
